title: Aegis Node Message Schema
description: Minimal A-F LangGraph node message contract. Nodes exchange only an artifact folder path. The artifact folder must contain README.md as the entry point.

artifact_path.description: Path to the artifact folder transferred between nodes. The folder must contain README.md.

quality_law_path.description: Absolute path to aegis_global_quality_law/SKILL.md. Every node must read this before its role skill.

reasoning_ledger_context_pack.description: Path to the exported reasoning ledger context pack JSON file.

status.description: Current agent processing result marker used by conditional graph routing.
